title_en: At the New Electric Market, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, Fully Invested!!!
description_en: At Tregu i Elektrik, on Ali Demi Street, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Totally Invested!!! The apartment is located on the first or third floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment has a gross surface of 113m2, facing East. The apartment is organized by a spacious living room, together with the cooking area and exit to the balcony, 2 bedrooms, one of which is a matrimonial one with a dedicated toilet and a room for children, and a toilet. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo, except for the children's room. The apartment has a high investment value and is invested in every detail, starting with Ac5 parquet, tiles selected from the most prestigious companies, sanitary ware from the best brands, unique furniture, quality double-glazed windows, etc.
